preconditions.description: d must be a positive integer between 1 and 500.
s must be a positive integer between 1 and 5000.
The input must consist of two positive integers d and s separated by space.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' or (int(stdout) > 0 and int(stdout) % d == 0 and sum(int(c) for c in stdout) == s)
postconditions.description: The output must be -1 if no valid n exists, otherwise it must be a positive integer divisible by d with a digit sum equal to s.
